title: Group related routes
summary: Express.js: Group related routes. Add a /pets route to the same router.
introduction: A Router groups routes under a shared prefix. GET /api/books uses both the prefix and inner path.
learningObjectives: Add a /pets route to the same router

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.
